answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, rewards vest against future work. The ledge is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the atlas. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The voyage of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
